listing.name: King's Field / Alexbeav PSXRecomp
listing.summary: Play King's Field with a native player built from your matching original disc.

steps.title: Supply the exact original disc
steps.instruction: Use your own Japan King's Field disc, SLPS-00017, with its single data track intact.

steps.title: Prepare the managed Windows or Linux player
steps.instruction: Select the complete matching disc as a CHD in Portcove. Portcove prepares and builds the player locally using the kit’s bundled OpenBIOS. On Linux, put your native C/C++ compiler, CMake, Ninja and Python 3 on PATH. The bundled emitters need glibc 2.14 and GLIBCXX 3.4.26. Choose Play after preparation.

steps.title: Prepare the Mac or a separate upstream-owned copy
steps.instruction: For standalone Linux setup, the packaged host needs glibc 2.29, GLIBCXX 3.4.26, OpenGL and zlib. On macOS 11 or later, choose the Intel or Apple Silicon ZIP for your system and put the Xcode Command Line Tools, CMake, Ninja and Python 3 on PATH. Run the upstream King_s_Field_Recompiled setup host and complete Generate & rebuild with your own matching original. Keep all tracks together for a CUE image. Add build-release/King_s_Field_Recompiled as the player, with build-release as the start folder. Use the kit’s supported BIOS instructions for an upstream-owned copy.

warnings: Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay for this package.
The source check uses first data-track identity and track count. Keep the full original disc intact. Mac setup, native gameplay and populated-save compatibility remain unobserved.
Older kits had relaunch or generated-target issues. Use the reviewed player name and keep the completed output with its creating kit.

references.title: Keep the data and runtime you actually use
references.instruction: For Portcove-managed copies, compatible replacement preserves declared saves, settings, mods and overlay captures. Keep the original disc separately. For an upstream-owned copy, retain the complete creating folder and back up your saves and settings before replacement.

presentation.manual_preparation: Provide your own Japan King's Field CHD (SLPS-00017) containing its single data track. Portcove runs the local kit build with bundled OpenBIOS and launches the completed player. Keep your original disc files independently. On Linux, use the native C/C++ compiler, CMake, Ninja and Python 3, with glibc 2.14 and GLIBCXX 3.4.26 for the kit’s emitters.
